Suppose that $\Ph\eta$ holds for some $\eta\in[1/2,1)$, with constant $C_0$. Then $\HN\in\AM\subseteq\Pitwo$. More precisely, there is an absolute constant $c$ such that, for every system $S$ as above, on putting \[ M=L\cdot2^{(n\log_2\sigma)^{c}},\qquad x_0=\Bigl\lceil\Bigl(\frac{52\,C_0\,M^4}{1-\eta}\Bigr)^{2/(1-\eta)}\Bigr\rceil , \] one has $A\le M$ and: \begin{enumerate} \item if $S$ has no solution in $\C^n$, then $\pi_S(x)\le A$ for all $x$; \item if $S$ has a solution in $\C^n$, then $\pi_S(x)\ge B$ for all $x\ge x_0$. \end{enumerate} The bit length of $x_0$ is at most $\frac{8}{1-\eta}\log_2M+O(1)$, the constant depending on $\eta$ and $C_0$; it is polynomial in the size of $S$.

\begin{enumerate} \item[(a)] The effective Chebotarev theorem of Hu \cite[Corollary~9.6, p.~56]{Hu} gives $\Ph\eta$ for every $\eta\in(7/8,1)$. \item[(b)] If $\Zh\theta$ holds for some $\theta\in[1/2,1)$, then $\Ph\eta$ holds for every $\eta\in(\theta,1)$. \end{enumerate}

If the theorem of Hu or the theorem of Cureton and Thorner just quoted is true, then $\HN\in\AM\subseteq\Pitwo$, with no further hypothesis. With Hu's Corollary~9.6 and $\eta=8/9$ the threshold of Theorem~\ref{thmA} is $x_0=\lceil(468\,C_0M^4)^{18}\rceil$, where $C_0$ is twice the constant of that corollary for $\varepsilon=1/72$.

statement: Suppose $\Ph\eta$ holds for some $\eta<1$; by Theorem~\ref{thmB} this is so if one of the theorems quoted before Corollary~\ref{corC} is true. Then: \begin{enumerate} \item the problem $\cl{DIM}$, whether the complex solution set of a system \eqref{eq:system} has dimension at least a given integer, is in $\AM$; \item the parametric Nullstellensatz $\cl{HNP}$, whether a system with coefficients in $\Z[y_1,\dots,y_k]$ has a solution over an algebraic closure of $\Q(y_1,\dots,y_k)$, is in $\AM$; \item the vanishing problem for Schubert coefficients in each of the types $A$, $B$, $C$, $D$ is in $\AM\cap\cl{coAM}$; it is not NP-hard unless $\cl{PH}=\Sigtwo$, and not coNP-hard unless $\cl{PH}=\Pitwo$; \item $\HN$ for systems given by arithmetic circuits, and the existence of a nonzero solution of a homogeneous such system, are in $\AM$; \item for a cone $Z\subseteq\C^t$ given by homogeneous circuit equations, $\dim Z$ and a homogeneous system of parameters of linear forms with integer coefficients can be computed in $\cl{FP}^{\Sigtwo}$. \end{enumerate}

Koiran: There are absolute constants $c_1$ and $c$ such that for every system $S$ as in \eqref{eq:system}, with $A$ as in \eqref{eq:A} and $M=L\cdot2^{(n\log_2\sigma)^c}$, one has $A\le M$ and the following hold. \begin{enumerate} \item If $S$ has no solution in $\C^n$, then $R_S$ has at most $A$ elements. \item If $S$ has a solution in $\C^n$, there are an irreducible polynomial $R\in\Z[X]$ of degree $N\le M$, with coefficients of bit size at most $M$, and an integer $a\ge1$ with $\log_2a\le M$, such that every prime $p\nmid a$ modulo which $R$ has a root belongs to $R_S$. \end{enumerate}
depends_on: Koiran, J. Complexity 12 (1996) and DIMACS TR 96-27 (cited, not proved again)

statement: Theorem~\ref{thmB} holds. In {\rm(a)} one may take $C_0=2c(\eta-7/8)$, where $c(\varepsilon)$ is the constant of \cite[Corollary~9.6]{Hu}. In {\rm(b)}, for every number field $K$ and every $x>2$, \begin{equation} \bigl|\pi_K(x)-\Li(x)\bigr|\le c_1\,x^{\theta}\Bigl(\frac{\log d_K}{1-\theta}+n_K\log x\Bigr), \end{equation} with the absolute constant $c_1$ of \cite[Theorem~1.1]{FSW}.

Koiran's Theorem~9 and Corollary~1 from $\Ph\eta$: Let $f\in\Z[X]$ be irreducible of degree $n\ge1$, with leading coefficient $a$ and discriminant $\Delta$, and let $K=\Q[X]/(f)$. For a prime $p$ let $W(p)$ be the number of roots of $f$ in $\F_p$, let $S(x)$ be as in \eqref{eq:K9}, and let $\pi_f(x)$ be the number of primes $p\le x$ with $W(p)\ge1$. Then for $x\ge2$: \begin{enumerate} \item $\bigl|S(x)-\bigl(\pi(x)-\pi_K(x)\bigr)\bigr|\le\frac n2\sqrt x+(2n+1)\log_2|a\Delta|$; \item if $\Ph\eta$ holds with constant $C_0$, then \begin{align*} |S(x)|&\le C_0\,(\log d_K+n+1)\,x^{\eta}+\tfrac n2\sqrt x+(2n+1)\log_2|a\Delta|,\\ \log d_K&\le(n-1)(n-2)\log|a|+\log|\Delta|; \end{align*} \item $\pi_f(x)\ge\frac1n\bigl(\pi(x)-\log_2|\Delta|-|S(x)|\bigr)$. \end{enumerate}

Koiran's Theorem~8 from $\Ph\eta$: Assume $\Ph\eta$ with constant $C_0$, where $1/2\le\eta<1$. Let $S$ have a solution in $\C^n$, and let $M$ be as in Proposition~\ref{prop:koiran}. Then for every $x\ge4$, \[ \pi_S(x)\ \ge\ \frac{x}{2M\log x}-19\,C_0\,M^3x^{\eta}. \]

The integer $d$ and linear forms $L_1,\dots,L_d$ with integer coefficients of bit length polynomial in $N$, such that $Z\cap\{L_1=\dots=L_d=0\}=\{0\}$, can be computed in polynomial time with an oracle in $\Sigtwo$. Such forms are a homogeneous system of parameters of the homogeneous coordinate ring of $Z$.
